signals.title: Coast Guard clarifies Subpart F obligations for entities with prior MTSA waivers
signals.summary: Prior physical-security waivers do not automatically exempt covered entities from 33 CFR Part 101 Subpart F. A Cybersecurity Assessment remains required before a cybersecurity waiver request.

signals.title: Coast Guard issues Cybersecurity Assessment scoping and process guidance
signals.summary: CG-5PC Policy Letter 01-26 emphasizes rigorous CSA scoping across vulnerabilities, threats, operational dependencies, and interdependencies that could contribute to disruption or a Transportation Security Incident.
